name: five module classes under ItemList and Map
source:
<?php

namespace Drupal\mod\Plugin\DataType;

use Drupal\Core\TypedData\Plugin\DataType\ItemList;
use Drupal\Core\TypedData\Plugin\DataType\Map;

class ValuesViaJmesPath extends ItemList {
	public function offsetExists($offset) { return isset($this->list[$offset]); }
	public function getIterator() { return new \ArrayIterator($this->list); }
	public function count() { return count($this->list); }
}
class EntitiesViaJmesPath extends ValuesViaJmesPath {
	public function offsetExists($offset) { return parent::offsetExists($offset); }
}
class ValuesFromJson extends ItemList {
	public function offsetExists($offset) { return true; }
}
class KeysFromJson extends ItemList {
	public function offsetExists($offset) { return false; }
	public function offsetGet($offset) { return $this->list[$offset]; }
	public function offsetSet($offset, $value) { $this->list[$offset] = $value; }
	public function offsetUnset($offset) { unset($this->list[$offset]); }
}
class ValuesFromFlavorJson extends Map {
	public function offsetExists($offset) { return true; }
	public function getIterator() { return new \ArrayIterator([]); }
	public function count() { return 0; }
}
